description: For home inspection, this completion sign-off form records visual inspection boundary, excluded systems, representative testing, safety limits, and client concerns. Its supporting evidence includes system observations, photos, readings, tested devices, inaccessible areas, seller disclosures, and defect locations.

subtitle: Home Inspection Completion Sign-Off Form: residential condition inspection and reporting using property, visual inspection boundary, and system observations.
title: Home Inspection Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during residential condition inspection and reporting when the home inspection record must identify property, client, occupancy, systems, utilities, weather, access limitations, and inspection agreement. Complete the applicable handoff for material finding summary, limitation record, recommended qualified evaluation, report delivery, and client acknowledgment.
